Du löst ein Single-Item Lot-Sizing-Problem mit Kapazitätsrestriktion über 20 Perioden. In jeder Periode kann produziert werden (mit fixen Setup-Kosten, falls produziert wird, plus variablen Produktionskosten pro Einheit), bis zur jeweiligen Kapazitätsgrenze. Nicht verkaufte Mengen werden mit Lagerkosten pro Einheit auf die Folgeperiode übertragen. Kein Anfangsbestand. Ziel: Minimiere die Gesamtkosten (Setup + Produktion + Lagerhaltung) über alle Perioden, sodass die Nachfrage jeder Periode exakt gedeckt wird.

Gib ausschließlich den Code in einem einzigen ```python ...``` Block zurück.

```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 10, "setup_cost": 482, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "2": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 176, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "3": {"demand": 34, "setup_cost": 257, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "4": {"demand": 10, "setup_cost": 105, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "5": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 211, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "6": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 218, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "7": {"demand": 11, "setup_cost": 393, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "8": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 469, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "9": {"demand": 33, "setup_cost": 346, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "10": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 123, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "11": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 244, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "12": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 228, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "13": {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 213, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "14": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 298, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "15": {"demand": 16, "setup_cost": 322, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "16": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 269, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "17": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 494, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "18": {"demand": 44, "setup_cost": 362, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "19": {"demand": 32, "setup_cost": 223, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "20": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 428, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 10, "2": 37, "3": 34, "4": 11, "5": 41, "6": 52, "7": 13, "8": 13,
    "9": 34, "10": 75, "11": 37, "12": 38, "13": 28, "14": 45, "15": 18,
    "16": 21, "17": 63, "18": 58, "19": 42, "20": 18
}

# Erstelle das Modell
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
periods = list(period_data.keys())
production = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere Gesamtkosten
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[p]["setup_cost"] * setup[p] +
        period_data[p]["prod_cost"] * production[p] +
        period_data[p]["holding_cost"] * inventory[p]
        for p in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for i, p in enumerate(periods):
    # Nachfrage decken
    if i == 0:
        model.addConstr(production[p] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[p] + inventory[periods[i-1]] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    
    # Kapazitätsbeschränkung
    model.addConstr(production[p] <= capacity[p] * setup[p])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[p] >= 0)

# Lösen des Modells
model.optimize()

# Ergebnisse
production_plan = {p: int(production[p].X) for p in periods}
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Ausgabe
import json
result = {"production": production_plan, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
```
